From: Karen Li <karen.li@nebulabank.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC 2 / ISO crosswalk + evidence delivery cadence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As we discussed during the security deep-dive, our compliance team needs a consolidated control crosswalk (SOC 2 + ISO 27001 + SIG where applicable) that maps Nebula Bank controls to Redwood controls, the evidence item for each assertion, and a proposed handoff schedule.

Specifically we need:
- a crosswalk (matrix) showing control IDs on our side and Redwood equivalents,
- a short runbook describing how Redwood plans to validate/produce each evidence item (who owns it, expected file type, and retention path),
- an evidence delivery schedule (we're aiming to ingest artifacts into our VDR between Jun 14-25), and
- any known gaps or compensating controls you recommend.

Can you confirm you can provide this by EOD Jun 7? Also please include point people for each control area since Nebula will be tracking SLA on evidence turnarounds.

Regards,

Karen Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Nebula Bank

Attachment: "procurement-rfi-template.xlsx" (spreadsheet stub)

Team — forwarding Nebula's ask. TL;DR: they want a consolidated SOC 2 / ISO / SIG crosswalk + a runbook + delivery schedule by EOD Jun 7 (their VDR intake window 14–25 Jun). I think we can hit this but need quick confirmations on owners and evidence finger-prints.

Proposed owner breakdown (please confirm or nominate alternate):
- System inventory + asset classification: Markus
- IAM + privileged access controls (SOC 2 CC6): Jonas
- Logging & retention evidence (Cloud logging exports, S3 indexes): Neha
- Encryption/KMS proofs: I can stitch together with infra but may lean on Markus for key provenance notes

Deliverable plan:
1) Control mapping matrix (master spreadsheet) — Jonas to start.
2) Runbook: short how-to per evidence artifact (format, expected path, point owner) — Mina draft + owners review.
3) Evidence manifest CSV (filenames, checksums, doc links) — Neha to populate.

Questions / clarifications:
- Do we want to provide redacted screenshots vs. full logs? Nebula asked to ingest into VDR, so manifest + sanitized artifacts preferred.
- I will attach a skeleton runbook and the matrix template to this thread by EOD today.

Please reply with confirmations and any blockers. If we can lock owners today I will coordinate a short sync with Karen on Jun 4 to align scope.

Thanks,

Karen — thanks for the clear ask and the intake template. Please find the consolidated materials attached and summarized below. We aligned internal owners and sketched a delivery cadence that fits your VDR ingestion window.

Attachments included (PDF/XLS/CSV stubs):
- redwood_control_runbook_v1.2.pdf — a control-by-control runbook with: owner, artifact type (screenshot, export, CSV), nominal retention path, redaction guidance, and turnaround SLA.
- control_mapping_matrix_NB_xwalk.xlsx — crosswalk mapping Nebula Bank control IDs to Redwood control IDs and mappings to SOC 2 / ISO / SIG references.
- evidence_delivery_manifest.csv — filename, file type, expected checksum placeholder, and delivery ETA.

Summary of timeline we propose:
- Jun 8–9: internal artifacts collected and redacted where necessary
- Jun 10: proof-of-concept artifact upload (sample docs) into Nebula VDR for validation
- Jun 14–18: bulk evidence delivery window (per your note)
- Jun 21–25: final catch-up window for any outstanding controls

Known gaps / notes:
- Some low-level operational logs (raw Kafka broker metrics) require custodial redaction before sharing; we propose sanitized aggregates as compensating evidence (documented in the runbook).
- For SIG items around subcontractor attestations, our vendors provide SOC reports; we included vendor references in the matrix and an owner for pull-through.

Action items / points of contact:
- Markus Klein — System inventory / KMS provenance (markus_klein@redwood.com)

- Neha Kapoor — Evidence manifest + delivery coordination (neha_kapoor@redwood.com)
- Mina Haddad — Runbook and overall delivery orchestration (mina_haddad@redwood.com)

Please confirm receipt and whether you want a short handoff call on Jun 9 to validate sample uploads; otherwise we'll proceed with the schedule above.
